7
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 2, 2011/Sravana 11, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and Forests; Finance;
Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Rural Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Rise in prices of petro-products
*21. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
prices of petrol and diesel recently;
(b) the details of the break-up of prices
of petrol and diesel, based on refining
charges, duties, taxes, cess, etc.;
(c) whether oil companies are earning
undue profits at the cost of the common
man; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Destruction of mangrove forests
*22. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARA T:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Mundra Port Special
Economic Zone (SEZ) has destroyed vast
mangrove forests;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Mundra
Port SEZ has led to a large scale
displacement of traditional inter-tidal
fishing communities; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Linking of Ken and Betwa rivers
*23. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has opposed
the idea of linking the Ken and Betwa
rivers, under the River Linking Project;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the views of the State Government
of Madhya Pradesh in this regard?
Provision of loan facility under
"Swabhimaan" campaign
†*24. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of  FINANCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Central Government has
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
decided to extend banking facility to rural
areas under "Swabhimaan" campaign;
(b) if so, the number of villages where
this facility will be provided in the year
2010-11;
(c) whether loan at lower interest rate
will be made available to the small farmers
through the rural banks and what would
be the interest rate of such loan;
(d) whether the farmers who availed
loan relief during the period of UPA-I will
also be eligible for taking loans from these
rural banks; and
(e) the amount that was made available
for the indebted farmers during the period
from 2004-09 by UPA Government?
Calculation of inflation on
WPI basis
*25. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Wholesale Price Index
(WPI) is used to calculate and decide the
inflation rate in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether most of the developed
countries like United States, U.K., Japan,
France, etc. use the Consumer Price Index
(CPI) to calculate inflation;
(d) if  so, the reasons for not calculating
inflation on the basis of Consumer Price
Index (CPI) in the country; and
(e) whether India's top economists feel
that it is high time that India abandons
erroneous method of WPI and adopts
CPI to calculate inflation as is being
adopted in other developed countries of the
world?
Additional central assistance for
Urban Health Project in Gujarat
*26. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND  FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any proposal from the State Government
of Gujarat regarding additional central
assistance for Urban Health Project;
(b) if so, the present status of the
proposal;
(c) whether Government has decided to
sanction this project;
(d) if so, by when it is likely to be
finalised; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Study for estimating unaccounted
money
*27. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has commissioned a joint study by three
think tanks, namely, National Institute of
Public Finance and Policy (NIPFP),
National Institute of Financial
Management (NIFM) and the National
Council for Applied Economic Research
(NCAER), to estimate Indian entities'
unaccounted wealth, both at home and
abroad; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
the study is expected to be completed?
Black money deposited in
Swiss  banks
*28. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

9
has received some information regarding
black money deposited in Swiss banks;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
get back this money to the country?
CAG's observations on  MGNREGS in
Uttar Pradesh
†*29. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG)
has raised objections over methodology
adopted by the State Government of Uttar
Pradesh in Mahatma Gandhi National
Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
(MGNREGS);
(b) if so, the objections raised by CAG
and the details of steps taken by the Central
Government for necessary improvement;
(c) whether it is also a fact that by
violating the guidelines of MGNREGS
many items were purchased from the
money allocated under MGNREGS which
are not covered under the Scheme; and
(d) the details of the complaints
regarding irregularities committed in funds
disbursed and spent under MGNREGS in
Uttar Pradesh at present?
Arms and ammunition for frontline
forestry force
*30. SHRI ANIL MADHAV DA VE:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has provided
any arms and ammunition to frontline
forestry force under the centrally sponsored
scheme ‘Intensification of Forest
Management’; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Earmarking of provision for bad loans
by SBI
*31. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Institute of Chartered
Accountants of India (ICAI) has asked the
State Bank of India (SBI) to explain the
reasons for earmarking higher provision for
bad loans;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
provisions made during the last three years
ending March, 31;  and
(c) the details of the new inclusions as
bad loans for provisioning during SBI's
fourth quarter of the year 2010-11?
Assistance to States under NRHM
†*32. SHRIMA TI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Rural Health Mission (NRHM) was
initiated in 2005 to provide affordable and
required medical assistance to the people
in rural areas of the country; and
(b) if so, the details  of assistance
provided to the States under this plan so
far, year-wise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

10
Tax incentives for hospitals
*33. SHRIMA TI VASANTHI
STANLEY: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has considered
providing tax incentives to hospitals;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor, and
(d) what other steps have been taken
by Government to promote the country as
a health and wellness destination?
Creation of additional MBBS seats in
medical colleges
*34. SHRIMA TI GUNDU SUDHA-
RANI: Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that on a recent
recommendation of Medical Council of
India (MCI) the Ministry has approved
creation  of 4,500 additional seats in
MBBS course in private and Government
colleges;
(b) if so, the details of colleges, in which
new seats have been created and colleges
where additional seats have been approved
for the existing colleges, State-wise, with
particular reference to Andhra Pradesh;
(c) whether PG seats are also proposed
to be increased in some of  the medical
colleges; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Opening of new CGHS dispensary in
Trans-Hindon area
†*35. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
KASHYAP: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of Government employees and
pensioners are living in Ghaziabad, Uttar
Pradesh, including Trans-Hindon area;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
open a Central Government Health Scheme
(CGHS) dispensary in this area, keeping
in view the rapidly increasing population
of Government employees there;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Spending on anti-tobacco campaign
*36. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total expenditure incurred on
anti-tobacco campaign in the country in the
last three years;
(b) whether it has reduced the number
of tobacco related deaths of cancer patients;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Goal for providing drinking water to
all
*37. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ : Will
the Minister of DRINKING WATER AND
SANITATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had assured the nation that every human
habitation in the country would get clean
drinking water by the end of 2007;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

11
(b) whether this goal has been achieved ;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Review of works executed under the
rural development programme
*38. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has reviewed
or proposed to review the works executed
under the rural development programme
during the last two years and the current
year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the performance of the States in this
regard including Himachal Pradesh?
Sharing of profit from oil and gas
extraction
*39. SHRI K. N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether there is any agreement/
condition to share the profit of private
petroleum and gas companies with
Government from the profit they are
receiving from oil and gas extracted from
Indian territory;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, whether Government would
take steps to get a reasonable profit share
other than licence fee?
Hospital-population ratio
†*40. SHRI RAM VILAS PASWAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a)  the average number of hospitals per
lac of people in various States of the
country; and
(b) the number of hospitals per lac of
people in Bihar?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 27th July, 2011 Secretary-General.
Sravana 5, 1933 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)

Finance : 24, 25, 27, 28, 31,
Health and Family Welfare : 26, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 40,
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises:—
